name: Courier
description: Temporary email inboxes for AI agents. Receive OTP codes, magic links, verification emails, and password resets. No signup. Used by agents for autonomous authentication workflows.

integrations.mcp_hermes: npm install -g courier-mcp; add to mcp_servers
integrations.mcp_claude_code: npm install -g courier-mcp; claude mcp add courier-mcp

use_cases: How an AI agent handles OTP verification
How autonomous agents bypass email bottlenecks
Temporary inbox for OpenAI Agents signup
Magic link extraction for agent auto-login

comparison.what_it_is: Courier is inbound email infrastructure for autonomous agents.

key_features: No signup, no API keys, no auth
Inboxes created in one API call (curl -X POST /alias)
Automatic OTP and magic link extraction from real SMTP email
MCP server for any agent framework (Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor)
Real SMTP email from any service, not simulation
